dialogues.jp:
ぱかりと丼の｛ふた／蓋｝を開ける。今夜は店屋物にした。
俺がカツ丼で、頼子さんが月見そばだ。
dialogues.en: I hurry to stuff food in my mouth and talk at the same time.
dialogues.text: I hurry to stuff food in my mouth and talk at the same time.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、はい……大丈夫だと、思います……」
dialogues.en: "Ah, yes...... I think I am okay......"
dialogues.text: "Ah, yes...... I think I am okay......"

dialogues.jp:
ちゅるんと、２、３本程度の麺を吸い込み、き
ちんと飲み込んでから返事をした。
dialogues.en:
She was partway through eating some noodles, but she chewed
them quickly and swallowed before she replied.
dialogues.text:
She was partway through eating some noodles, but she chewed
them quickly and swallowed before she replied.

dialogues.jp:
「はぐぅ……もし、腹減ったら……ぐぐ……買
　い置きとか割と……んぐぐ……うっ！？」
dialogues.en:
"Nyum, mmph... But if you're still hungry... gmph... we have
some food in stock.... Ahnyumph...... Ug!?"
dialogues.text:
"Nyum, mmph... But if you're still hungry... gmph... we have
some food in stock.... Ahnyumph...... Ug!?"

dialogues.jp: こ、呼吸がっ。
dialogues.en: I can't breathe!
dialogues.text: I can't breathe!

dialogues.jp:
びゅしっ！　俺の手が、｛ししど／宍戸｝｛ばいけん／梅軒｝の鎌のごとく
湯飲みにからみつく。
dialogues.en: I grab my tea like a drowning man clutching at a straw.
dialogues.text: I grab my tea like a drowning man clutching at a straw.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、だ、大丈夫ですか……？」
dialogues.en: "Ah, are you okay......?"
dialogues.text: "Ah, are you okay......?"

dialogues.jp:
手にお茶が降り注ごうが、一気に口元に持って
いった。
dialogues.en:
I spilled some tea on my hand when I grabbed the cup, but I
quickly bring the tea to my mouth.
dialogues.text:
I spilled some tea on my hand when I grabbed the cup, but I
quickly bring the tea to my mouth.

dialogues.jp: 「んっ、んっ、んっ、……はあ……」
dialogues.en: "Glug, glug, glug...... Hahhh......"
dialogues.text: "Glug, glug, glug...... Hahhh......"

dialogues.jp:
ようやく人心地がつく。正月に餅をつまらせる
老人の心境だった。
dialogues.en:
I finally feel alive. I could have died like old people who
choke to death on a big candy.
dialogues.text:
I finally feel alive. I could have died like old people who
choke to death on a big candy.

dialogues.jp:
と、目の前に座っていたはずの頼子さんが消え、
背中に軽い衝撃があるのに気が付いた。
dialogues.en:
Then I realize that Yoriko-san, who had been sitting right
in front of me, has disappeared, and I feel a light pat on
my back.
dialogues.text:
Then I realize that Yoriko-san, who had been sitting right
in front of me, has disappeared, and I feel a light pat on
my back.

dialogues.jp: ぽてぽてぽて……。優しく、背中が叩かれる。
dialogues.en: Pat, pat... Her touch is gentle.
dialogues.text: Pat, pat... Her touch is gentle.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あの……喉……平気、ですか……？」
dialogues.en: "Ah...... Is your throat... okay......?"
dialogues.text: "Ah...... Is your throat... okay......?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「食べ物を……詰まらせたんですよね……」
dialogues.en: "You were choking...... right......?"
dialogues.text: "You were choking...... right......?"

dialogues.jp: ぽてぽてぽて……。
dialogues.en: "Ah, yeah..."
dialogues.text: "Ah, yeah..."

dialogues.jp:
手の平は柔らかく、何だかマッサージでも受け
ているようで、気持ちがいい。
dialogues.en:
Pat, pat, pat...... Her palm's so soft, and it feels good,
as if I was getting a massage.
dialogues.text:
Pat, pat, pat...... Her palm's so soft, and it feels good,
as if I was getting a massage.

dialogues.jp:
ずっとやってもらいたい気がしたが、麺が伸び
てしまうのではと思い直す。
dialogues.en: I want her to carry on, but her noodles will get cold.
dialogues.text: I want her to carry on, but her noodles will get cold.

dialogues.jp: 「ああ、うん、ありがと。もう大丈夫だから」
dialogues.en: "Ah, thank you so much. I'm fine now."
dialogues.text: "Ah, thank you so much. I'm fine now."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「そうですか……良かったです……」
dialogues.en: "That's good...... I was worried......"
dialogues.text: "That's good...... I was worried......"

dialogues.jp:
二人、食事を再開する。今度は俺も、無茶な食
べ方はしない。
dialogues.en:
We start eating dinner again. This time I'm not eating so
fast.
dialogues.text:
We start eating dinner again. This time I'm not eating so
fast.

dialogues.jp: 「そういや、料理の本、どのくらい読んだ？」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, have you been reading the cookery books?"
dialogues.text: "Anyway, have you been reading the cookery books?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、はい、その……まだ、最初の方です……」
dialogues.en: "Ah, yes. But I haven't finished yet......"
dialogues.text: "Ah, yes. But I haven't finished yet......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「どんな感じ？　読んでみて。出来そう？」
dialogues.en: "How do you like it? Do you think you can cook?"
dialogues.text: "How do you like it? Do you think you can cook?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.en: "Ah, ummm......"
dialogues.text: "Ah, ummm......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「初めて知る言葉がたくさんあって……面白い
　です」
dialogues.en:
"It is very interesting because...... there are so many new
words I have never heard or read."
dialogues.text:
"It is very interesting because...... there are so many new
words I have never heard or read."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「……初めて知る言葉？」
dialogues.en: "......New words?"
dialogues.text: "......New words?"

dialogues.jp:
それがマニアックな単語である事を願いつつ、
俺は｛たず／訊｝ねた。
dialogues.en:
I ask her what kind of words they are, hoping that they're
some kind of technical terms.
dialogues.text:
I ask her what kind of words they are, hoping that they're
some kind of technical terms.

dialogues.en: "......For example?"
dialogues.text: "......For example?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「そうですね……」
箸を置き、小首を傾げる。
dialogues.en: She puts down her chopsticks and tilts her head to think.
dialogues.text: She puts down her chopsticks and tilts her head to think.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「千切り……ですとか。あと、そう……みじん
　切り……ですとか。あとは……」
dialogues.en:
"'Cutting into strips'...... and oh,...... 'mince'......
And......"
dialogues.text:
"'Cutting into strips'...... and oh,...... 'mince'......
And......"

dialogues.jp:
四次元ポケットのように言葉がさくりさくりと
飛び出してくるが、そのどれもがこの俺でさえ
｛なじ／馴染｝みのあるものだった。
dialogues.en:
She gives me many words in sequence, but all of them are
familiar and general words.
dialogues.text:
She gives me many words in sequence, but all of them are
familiar and general words.

dialogues.jp: あ、｛めまい／眩暈｝が……。
dialogues.en: Oh, give me a break......
dialogues.text: Oh, give me a break......

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「私……私……一生懸命覚えますね……」
dialogues.en:
"I...... I...... I will try my hardest to remember them
all......"
dialogues.text:
"I...... I...... I will try my hardest to remember them
all......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉さんに……美味しいお料理、食べてもら
　いたいから……」
dialogues.en: "I want to cook delicious meals...... for you."
dialogues.text: "I want to cook delicious meals...... for you."

dialogues.jp:
頼子さんの顔を見つめ、つくづくとため息をつ
きたくなる。
dialogues.en: I stare at her and want to sigh.
dialogues.text: I stare at her and want to sigh.

dialogues.jp: 反則だよな、その笑顔は……。
dialogues.en: It's not fair. Her smile is so......
dialogues.text: It's not fair. Her smile is so......

dialogues.jp:
うなずく以外、道が残ってないじゃないか、ほ
んと。
dialogues.en: She leaves me no choice but to nod in agreement.
dialogues.text: She leaves me no choice but to nod in agreement.

dialogues.jp: ◆みじん切り、千切り◆
dialogues.en: ◆Yoriko◆
dialogues.text: ◆Yoriko◆

dialogues.jp:
夕食時、頼子さんに料理の本はどれくらい読ん
だのか尋ねてみたところまだ初めのほうらしい。
dialogues.en: "Let's eat."
dialogues.text: "Let's eat."

dialogues.jp:
みじん切りや千切りをという言葉をはじめて知っ
たという頼子さん。
dialogues.en:
I open the lid of my rice bowl. Tonight we ordered a
takeaway. I ordered a rice bowl with fried pork and Yoriko
ordered noodles with an egg on top.
dialogues.text:
I open the lid of my rice bowl. Tonight we ordered a
takeaway. I ordered a rice bowl with fried pork and Yoriko
ordered noodles with an egg on top.

dialogues.jp:
激しく不安なものを感じたが、彼女の笑顔の前
にそんなことおくびにも出せない俺だった。
dialogues.en:
"Ahhmmnh... Can you... nyom, mumph... get full...
ahhmnyum... with that?"
dialogues.text:
"Ahhmmnh... Can you... nyom, mumph... get full...
ahhmnyum... with that?"
